citations.quote: Innate: During each basic attack or casting of Pierce, Kalista can optionally choose a target direction to quickly dash to.
For each stack beyond the first, the target is dealt additional physical damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Attack-linked dashes accompany stacking physical damage.

citations.quote: While she and the ally bound as the Oathsworn are within tether range of each other, they can both interact with Soul-Mark and Fate's Call.

core_mechanics.summary: A bound ally enables Soul-Mark and Fate's Call within tether range.

title: Kalista overview

citations.quote: Basic Attack: Kalista's basic attack windup is uncancellable except by casting Rend, although she can input a new attack command to change her target during the windup.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Her attack windup is normally uncancellable; Rend and attack retargeting have specific interactions.

citations.quote: Innate: During each basic attack or casting of Pierce, Kalista can optionally choose a target direction to quickly dash to.

core_mechanics.summary: Attacks and Pierce enable directional dashes.

citations.quote: Kalista cannot dash while immobilized or grounded
Kalista begins the game with an exclusive Black Spear that she can activate on an allied champion to deem them Oathsworn, forming a tether together.

core_mechanics.summary: Black Spear designates a bound allied champion.

purpose: Recognize repeated repositioning and the Oathsworn bond.
title: Martial Poise

citations.quote: Active: Kalista throws a spear in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit.

core_mechanics.summary: A directional spear deals physical damage.

citations.quote: If Pierce kills 1 or more targets, the spear continues onward to transfer all of the last killed target's Rend stacks to the next enemy hit that survives.

core_mechanics.summary: Kills let the spear continue and transfer Rend stacks.

purpose: Recognize spear penetration and stack-transfer danger.
title: Pierce

citations.quote: If both Soul-Marks are applied to the same target, they take bonus magic damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Shared marks trigger bonus magic damage.

citations.quote: Active: Kalista summons a Sentinel that patrols back and forth on a path along the target direction, granting sight of its surroundings as it travels.

purpose: Recognize shared-target damage and scouting patrols.
title: Sentinel

citations.quote: Rend's cast also empowers the in-flight missiles of Kalista's basic attacks and Pierce to apply Rend's effects to their targets immediately upon hitting them.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Projectiles already in flight can apply Rend's effects on arrival.

citations.quote: Kalista's basic attacks on-hit and Pierce apply a stack of Rend to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits

core_mechanics.summary: Attacks and Pierce build and refresh spear stacks.

citations.quote: For each stack beyond the first, the target is dealt additional physical damage.
If Rend kills at least one target, its cooldown is reset and Kalista restores mana.

core_mechanics.summary: A Rend kill resets its cooldown and restores mana.

purpose: Recognize accumulating burst, slows and repeat-cast danger.
title: Rend

citations.quote: Kalista cleanses the Oathsworn from all crowd control and renders them invulnerable and untargetable for the duration

core_mechanics.summary: Retrieving the Oathsworn cleanses and protects them.

citations.quote: Upon the dash ending by collision or arriving to the targeted location, the Oathsworn knocks back all nearby enemies and keeps them airborne for a set duration

core_mechanics.summary: The ally's outgoing dash ends with nearby knockback and airborne crowd control.

purpose: Recognize the rescue and outgoing area engage.
title: Fate's Call
